description.narrative: Programmet ASSP syftar till att erbjuda primär hälsovård till ca. 2,7 miljoner människor i 5 geografiska områden i landet. Insatsen ska bland annat bidra till att stärka det nationella hälsosystemet samt uppbyggnad av grundläggande hälsoservice. Fokus kommer att inriktas mot mödra- och barnhälsa samt säkerställande av sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och rättigheter.

The programme ASSP aims to provide primary health care to approximately 2,7 million persons in 5 geographic areas in the Democratic Republic of Congo, whilst strengthening the health systems. The programme outcome will be increased coverage with essential reproductive, maternal and child health services in DFID supported health zones.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The Acces aux Soins de Sante Primaires (ASSP) delivered good results in a very challenging context during 2013-2014 and managed to balance between ensuring service delivery on the one hand and strengthening systems on the other. Overall the programme performed well and progress towards expected outcomes were good.
The programme contributed for example with: 1) 500,000 births attended by skilled health personnel. 2) 500,000 children vaccinated against measles. 3) 200,000 long-lasting insecticide-treated bednets distributed to pregnant women 4) 170,000 children reached with nutrition programme at health facility level.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
